The day of the NHK Mile Cup arrived, 
featuring Seeking the Pearl in the lineup.

Because the date was so close to the 
Japanese Derby, her path completely 
diverged here from her classmates pursuing 
the Classic Triple Crown.

However, El Condor Pasa shed no tears. To 
prove she was capable of taking on the 
world, she headed toward the race brimming 
with fighting spirit.
